units.title: SG-1.2.2 · Create the typed UI store in game/frontend/src/store
Act: Create uiStore.ts with drawer and modal state and actions
Act: Add sound and settings flags and toggles to uiStore.ts
Act: Finalize named exports of useUiStore, UiState and ModalId
Verify: Drawer and modal store unit tests

tests.name: defaults drawerOpen to false and modal to null
tests.title: uiStore drawer and modal > defaults drawerOpen to false and modal to null
tests.scenario: Given the store is reset to its initial state, When the state is read, Then drawerOpen is false and modal is null

tests.name: toggleDrawer flips drawerOpen from false to true and back to false
tests.title: uiStore drawer and modal > toggleDrawer flips drawerOpen from false to true and back to false
tests.scenario: Given drawerOpen is false, When toggleDrawer is called twice, Then drawerOpen is true after the first call and false after the second

tests.name: openModal sets modal to contribution and closeModal resets it to null
tests.title: uiStore drawer and modal > openModal sets modal to contribution and closeModal resets it to null
tests.scenario: Given modal is null, When openModal('contribution') then closeModal are called, Then modal is 'contribution' and then null

units.title: Verify: Sound and settings store unit tests

tests.id: defaults soundEnabled to true and settingsOpen to false
tests.name: uiStore sound and settings > defaults soundEnabled to true and settingsOpen to false
tests.title: defaults soundEnabled to true and settingsOpen to false
tests.scenario: Given the store is reset, When state is read, Then soundEnabled is true and settingsOpen is false

tests.id: toggleSound flips soundEnabled and leaves settingsOpen, drawerOpen and modal unchanged
tests.name: uiStore sound and settings > toggleSound flips soundEnabled and leaves settingsOpen, drawerOpen and modal unchanged
tests.title: toggleSound flips soundEnabled and leaves settingsOpen, drawerOpen and modal unchanged
tests.scenario: Given settingsOpen, drawerOpen and modal are set, When toggleSound is called, Then soundEnabled becomes false and the other three are unchanged

tests.id: toggleSettings flips settingsOpen and leaves soundEnabled unchanged
tests.name: uiStore sound and settings > toggleSettings flips settingsOpen and leaves soundEnabled unchanged
tests.title: toggleSettings flips settingsOpen and leaves soundEnabled unchanged
tests.scenario: Given the store is reset, When toggleSettings is called twice, Then settingsOpen goes true then false and soundEnabled stays true

units.title: Verify: Typed useUiStore hook export unit tests

tests.name: renders the initial soundEnabled value selected from the store
tests.title: useUiStore hook renders the initial soundEnabled value selected from the store
tests.scenario: Given the store has soundEnabled true, When a probe component selects soundEnabled, Then it shows 'sound:true'

tests.name: re-renders the selector consumer when toggleSound is called inside act
tests.title: useUiStore hook re-renders the selector consumer when toggleSound is called inside act
tests.scenario: Given a probe showing 'sound:true', When toggleSound() is called inside act, Then it shows 'sound:false'

tests.name: exposes the ModalId type as the contribution modal identifier
tests.title: useUiStore hook exposes the ModalId type as the contribution modal identifier
tests.scenario: Given a ModalId value 'contribution', When openModal is called with it, Then the modal state is 'contribution'

units.title: REQ · UI store exposes drawer and modal state with toggleDrawer, openModal and closeModal
REQ · UI store exposes sound and settings flags with toggleSound and toggleSettings
REQ · A typed useUiStore hook is exported for components to import
Evidence: UI store unit tests pass
